description: This file contains functions for interacting with a Supabase backend, including user authentication, transaction management, alert handling, and data retrieval for insights. It exports multiple asynchronous functions used as a public API for database operations related to transactions, alerts, and user info.

methods.name: requireSupabase
methods.description: Ensures a Supabase client is configured and available, throws an error if not.

methods.name: getCurrentUserId
methods.description: Returns the current authenticated user's ID or throws an error if not authenticated.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Fetches transactions for a user, ordered by date and creation time.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Inserts a new transaction record into the database.

methods.name: updateTransaction
methods.description: Updates a transaction identified by its ID with provided data.

methods.name: deleteTransaction
methods.description: Deletes a transaction by its ID.

methods.name: listAlerts
methods.description: Fetches alerts for a user, ordered by creation time.

methods.name: dismissAlert
methods.description: Deletes or dismisses an alert by its ID.

methods.name: listInsightsSourceTransactions
methods.description: Fetches transactions for insights, filtered by date range and user.
